pitchEn: Eternal Flame is a reflex game about keeping a single candle burning in the dark. Threats close in from every side, each announced on the rim before it strikes: wind, whirlwinds and thieving torches from the left and right, water, rain and downpours from above, swords, stones and arrows head-on. Meet each one with the right guard for the right direction — raise the giant hand to the side, cover the flame with your palm from above, or lift the shield up front — and hold the guard through storms. Survive across 12 hand-tuned nights with wider windows, longer holds and a short all-blocking dome you earn along the way. One-handed touch controls, fully offline, no accounts.
newFeaturesEn: First release of Eternal Flame: a canvas-2D flame-guarding reflex game across 12 nights with side, overhead and frontal threats, hold-to-parry storms, earned abilities and a short protective dome, one-handed touch controls, in 15 languages.

dataHandling.notes: Fully offline game. No accounts, no network. Only the chosen interface language and local progress are stored on-device.

reviewerRemarksEn: Launch the app; on first run pick one of 15 languages and continue past the intro and the policy screen. In the game a candle burns in the center and threats approach from the sides, above and the front, each marked on the rim. Raise the giant hand (left/right) against wind from a side, cover with the palm (up) against water from above, and lift the shield up front against blades and stones — hold the guard for storms. Defend the flame until each night's goal is met. No account, login, or internet connection is required.
